brief.subject: IRS sets 2027 tax numbers; state ballots shake up taxes
brief.headline: IRS Releases 2027 Inflation Adjustments as Voters Reshape State Tax Rules
brief.dek: New 2027 brackets and deductions, big ballot outcomes in Florida, Colorado and Washington, and over 6,500 new opportunity zones.
brief.lede: The IRS has published tax year 2027 inflation adjustments for nearly 70 provisions, including brackets and the standard deduction. These are the figures for planning next year's withholding and estimated payments.

sections.heading: IRS Posts 2027 Inflation Adjustments
bullets: Nearly 70 tax provisions got inflation updates for tax year 2027, the IRS says.
Income tax brackets and the standard deduction are among the items adjusted.
Owners and freelancers should use the new figures when planning 2027 estimated payments and payroll withholding.

sections.heading: Election Day Rewrites State Tax Rules
bullets: Florida voters approved Amendment 3, a property tax cut that forces local governments to decide which services to trim.
Colorado's Amendment 87 backers claim victory on a measure raising income taxes on high earners.
Washington's high-earner income tax stands after Initiative 645 backers conceded defeat.
Business owners in these states should watch for local fee, levy and service changes as rollouts begin.

sections.heading: Over 6,500 Opportunity Zones Named
bullets: Treasury and the IRS designated more than 6,500 communities as opportunity zones.
The designations span all 50 states, the District of Columbia and five U.S. territories.
Owners weighing new locations or investments should check whether their area made the list.

sections.heading: AICPA Seeks Penalty Relief for Trusts
bullets: The AICPA asked the IRS to waive 2026 estimated tax penalties for certain estates and trusts.
Open questions remain on how the provision fits with rules specific to estates and trusts.
Bookkeepers handling fiduciary returns should hold off on final penalty calculations until the IRS responds.

brief.seo_description: IRS 2027 brackets and standard deduction, state tax ballot results, 6,500+ opportunity zones, and AICPA's call for estate and trust penalty relief.

items.title: Proposed Rule: Guidance on Eligible Investments for Trump Accounts; Hearing
items.snippet: This document provides a notice of proposed rulemaking (CC- 00349938-26) published in the Federal Register on August 21, 2026.
